title: Rank-BM25 boundary robustness
objective: Make all three BM25 variants handle empty corpora, all-empty documents, non-positive top_n values, and negative batch document indices without regressing ordinary ranking behavior.
boundaries: The task evaluates boundary behavior in rank_bm25.py, not the full quality of the rank-bm25 project.
The public and hidden cases are ReproPilot contracts, not upstream-maintainer tests or an official benchmark.
A passing original test suite establishes compatibility with two upstream loading tests only.
This baseline contains no model request, candidate patch, Keep decision, or hidden-validation pass claim.
